purpose: Small fa/en retrieval benchmark for WP-C (CONTRACT-E1 section 8). It measures the MECHANISM (legacy-style normalised exact substring vs. R1 direct+metadata+graph retrieval) on 18 synthetic documents written by the same author as the queries and as the candidate annotations. It is NOT an estimate of recall on a real corpus, and the annotations are hand-written stand-ins for what an annotator model might produce (the 'R1 without annotations' column shows how much R1 owes to them). Queries that neither system can answer are kept on purpose.
